# Rising Tide. 125 connected story scenes.
#! Directions: @ EVENT BACKGROUND METHOD SUBJECT CAST HOLD|MOVE
# > changes a shot before the next message. Named subjects live in staging.json.
# Physical cast is local to a shot; radio voices never appear in the scenery.
# Inserts use a named object. MOVE eases to it once; HOLD stays on it.
# Narration is fiction, not evidence of racing gameplay.

@ D01 BENCH PAN JACK - MOVE
NIA: Mind the jack. It rolls toward anything expensive.
> BENCH PAN KEYS - MOVE
YOU: Is that why you parked my car beside it?
> GARAGE FACE DOOR NIA HOLD
NIA: Your car? These are the garage keys. The car keys are the small, disappointing ones.
YOU: You said there was work.
NIA: There is. Sunline needs another pair of hands, and tonight the club needs another driver.
> MEET FACE CREW MINA,NIA HOLD
MINA: First night, first photograph. Try to look as if you meant to come here.
YOU: What do I owe you?
> MEET FACE CREW NIA,MINA HOLD
NIA: Bring the car home straight. We can work out the rest over breakfast.

@ D02 MEET FACE CREW JULES,MINA HOLD
JULES: That's Nia's loaner. Does she know you've taken it outside?
YOU: She gave me the keys.
JULES: She gave me a spanner once. Different expression on her face, though.
MINA: Jules delivers everything except a straight answer. You're in the next club heat together.
> START PAN GRID - MOVE
JULES: Start beside me. Finish wherever your dignity permits.

@ D03 GARAGE FACE CAR NIA HOLD
NIA: Mrs. Vale paid for her repair in oranges. Again.
YOU: Can oranges pay the rent?
NIA: Not yet. Tonight's corner-store meet can cover the electricity, though.
> START FACE BARRIER CALDER HOLD
CALDER: Store closes at nine. Barriers go up after. Nobody moves until my marshal gives the all-clear.
YOU: You're Calder?
CALDER: Depends who's asking. If you scratch that loaner, I'm the one Nia phones.

@ D04 PAPERS PAN LEASE - MOVE

NIA: Good. And put that envelope somewhere I don't have to look at it while I eat.

@ D05 MARINA RADIO FOOD - MOVE

@ D06 MEET FACE GRID KADE,JULES HOLD

@ S22 PITWALL RADIO TIMES - MOVE
REN: Final qualifying. One clear lap, and then another if the first one doesn't come together.
YOU: Not the whole season in one corner.
> PITWALL RADIO TIMES - MOVE
REN: You're becoming difficult to lecture. I'll have to start bringing longer pencils.
NIA: Save the lecture for the cooldown. We want to hear all of it.

@ S23 MEMORIES PAN SIGN - MOVE
MINA: The final entry still says Sunline Garage. Same name as the old sign.
> MEMORIES PAN CHAIRS - MOVE
NIA: The people holding it up have changed. It shouldn't belong to one person just because my dad painted it first.
> GARAGE FACE DOOR NIA,JULES HOLD
YOU: What are you thinking?
NIA: A proper stake for the people doing the work. We'll write it together after the final.
> MEMORIES PAN CHAIRS - MOVE
JULES: Can my stake include a chair that doesn't fold unexpectedly?

@ S24 FINALE FACE PADDOCK VOSS HOLD
VOSS: Before I started signing entries, I used to enter them. You'll be racing me tomorrow, not my office.
> FINALE FACE PADDOCK VOSS,NIA HOLD
YOU: With Aster's marshals checking both of us?
> OFFICE PAN LICENSE - MOVE
VOSS: The same rules for both of us. The contract is settled; whatever happens tomorrow, your independent terms remain yours.
> FINALE FACE PADDOCK NIA,VOSS HOLD
NIA: Then we can finally have an ordinary argument about driving.
VOSS: I look forward to being difficult to pass.

@ S25 FINALE FACE PADDOCK NIA,VOSS HOLD
NIA: First night, I asked you to bring the car home straight. Seems a small instruction for all this.
YOU: It was a good place to start.
VOSS: Same start for everyone. Same obligations at the finish. Ready?
YOU: Ready.
> NIGHTFINAL MONTAGE CORNER - MOVE
NARRATOR: THE COASTLINE FINAL. Under the floodlights, Sunline takes the flag ahead of Voss. The crew waits on the pit wall.
> NIGHTFINAL PAN FLAG - MOVE
SABLE: There it is. A result nobody needs to explain away.
> NIGHTFINAL FACE FLAG VOSS,NIA HOLD
VOSS: Well driven. Keep your promise to the people who brought you here. That's harder than a final lap.
NIA: We'll keep it together.
> GARAGE MONTAGE DOOR - MOVE
NARRATOR: DAWN AT SUNLINE. The shutters rise over familiar tools, too many chairs, and a car waiting outside the open door.
> MEMORIES FACE CHAIRS MINA,JULES HOLD
MINA: Someone new. Says Calder told them we might have work.
JULES: Do they know what the small, disappointing keys are for?
> BENCH PAN JACK - MOVE
YOU: I'll show them. Mind the jack. It rolls toward anything expensive.
> MEMORIES PAN CHAIRS - MOVE
NIA: Put another chair by the door.
